subject.statement: Do Kwon was sentenced to 15 years in prison on 11 December 2025.

summary: As of 2026-10-01, the claim that Do Kwon was sentenced to 15 years in prison on 11 December 2025 is TRUE with high confidence. Multiple reputable outlets (WSJ, Coindesk, Le Monde) and the official U.S. Department of Justice press release confirm the sentence length and date. A separate, older Montenegro ruling concerning a four‑month sentence does not contradict this finding.

findings.statement: Do Kwon (full legal name Do Hyeong Kwon) was sentenced to a prison term by a U.S. federal court on 11 December 2025.
The exact length of the prison sentence imposed on Do Kwon is 15 years, and it was imposed on 11 December 2025.

conflict_notes: A 2023 Montenegro court ruling noted a four‑month prison sentence for Do Kwon (protos.com). This concerns a separate, earlier case in Montenegro and does not contradict the 2025 U.S. 15‑year sentence.
